title: OSA Analyzer: optical spectrum analysis for fiber refractive-index sensors
description: Desktop application and Python package for analysing optical spectrum analyzer (Yokogawa AQ6370) measurements of fiber refractive-index sensors: resonance tracking with sub-sample wavelength estimation, sensitivity fitting with uncertainty and detection limit, and machine-learning RI regression with leakage-safe evaluation. Every exported result carries a provenance record (software versions, settings, input file hashes).
